pr_body:
This makes previously-internal API public to make it easier to consume and customise `MapIdentityApi<TUser>()` HTTP endpoints.

Fixes #49424
pr_comments: Did the namespace Models come up in review?

> Did the namespace Models come up in review?

You mean this?

> - What do we think about including `DTO` in a namespace?
>  - We'd like to avoid it, but we don't want to drop all these types directly in `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity`
>  - `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.Objects`?
>  - `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.Data`? Let's do this!
>  - Let's move `AccessTokenResponse` directly into `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.BearerToken`

I am a little sad that none of these are available outside the shared framework though. It's tempting to move it to Microsoft.Extensions.Identity.Core so it can be consumed as a package from non-ASP.NET projects, but then none of the `<see cref="...">` in the doc comments would show up. That did not come up in API review, so I left them in the assemblies they were in previously.

issue_context.title: Expose AccessTokenResponse from the new BearerToken AuthenticatonHandler
